status: Exploratory follow-up; specified before running these additional experiments, not an original preregistration

missingness.dataset: BRFSS original benchmark_train row IDs only
missingness.model: LogisticRegression C=1, no class weights, max_iter=1500
missingness.comparison: Identical pipeline with and without numeric missing-value indicators

prevalence.method: Class-constant reweighting, keeping within-class score distributions fixed

calibration.source: BRFSS held-out test, before and after existing validation-selected sigmoid
calibration.output: Offset intercept with slope fixed to 1; jointly fitted intercept and slope; mean predicted minus observed

limitations: No future-event horizon or treatment thresholds transferred from Weng et al.
Descriptive folds are not independent population confidence intervals
Hypothetical prevalence weights do not establish transfer to Kazakhstan
Calibration summaries do not prove calibration for every subgroup
